purpose: Resolve whether the author-supplied seqinitial equations produce the same valid stationary occupancy as the kinetic transition graph before sealing the Stage B source transfer.

source.citation: Khaliq, Gouwens, and Raman 2003 author-supplied ModelDB 48332 rsg.mod

runtime.version_policy: record exact installed version in the output; do not alter source NMODL
runtime.compile_policy: compile the authenticated source alone in a fresh temporary directory
runtime.voltage_control: SEClamp at each initialization voltage with 1e-9 Mohm series resistance
runtime.temperature_policy: not applicable; rsg.mod contains no temperature or Q10 term

observations: all 13 native occupancies immediately after finitialize
all occupancies after one fixed-voltage 0.001 ms source-native step
maximum absolute state change after that step

decision_rules.SOURCE_NATIVE_VALID_STATIONARY: Every initial occupancy is nonnegative, sums to one within 1e-10, and changes by at most 1e-8 after one fixed-voltage step at every voltage.
decision_rules.SOURCE_NATIVE_INITIALIZATION_DEFECT: Any native occupancy is negative or any maximum one-step change exceeds 1e-8 while voltage remains fixed.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_EVIDENCE: Source, runner, compiler, runtime, output, or voltage control cannot be authenticated.

boundary: This diagnostic may classify source-native initialization only. It cannot authorize graph-equilibrium substitution, parameter fitting, conductance fitting, Stage B promotion, or whole-cell integration.
provenance_exempt: prospective non-executed oracle contract; contains no observed result
